# Feature: Offline e2e

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-14 — issue #39 -->

## Intent
G-005 / FR-025 / NFR-012: once CLI, browser, and adapters are local, a blocked network must not break a run or emit hidden product requests.

## Preconditions
- Fixture e2e (#12-ish) and Quick Scan (#18) exist
- Local API (#20) is loopback-only

## Happy Path
- [ ] Offline harness blocks non-loopback requests and expects 0 product requests (CDP/loopback allowed)
- [ ] Quick Scan of the fixture reaches `completed` or a local infra error, not a DNS hang
- [ ] Docs state the prerequisite "packages already local"
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches

## Edge Cases
- [ ] DNS / non-loopback `fetch` is blocked in the harness
- [ ] No product analytics via `HTTP_PROXY`

## Regression
- [ ] Existing fixture e2e still passes
- [ ] Scope: e2e offline harness + CLI/dashboard no telemetry — Playwright browser download itself is out

## Assumptions
- First `npx` download without network may fail; that is documented, not tested as success

## Security Coverage
- NFR-012 / T-013: 0 outgoing product requests
- F-03: no telemetry tokens

## Screenshots
Not applicable.

## Implementation Notes
- `e2e/offline.spec.ts` aborts non-loopback Playwright routes; fixture must still render.
- `tests/security/t013-offline.test.ts` blocks `globalThis.fetch` except loopback; Quick Scan completes; local API POST 202; CLI source has no telemetry/HTTP_PROXY.
- README: packages must already be local; first npx download may fail offline.
